offence: Enter or leave, or attempt to enter or leave, Singapore except at an authorised point (s.5(2)/(4)), unless compelled by accident or other reasonable cause
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Bailable (no special penalty in s.5 — general penalty s.58 max 6 months)
punishment: s.5(5) creates the offence but states no special penalty. General penalty s.58: fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both

offence: Non-citizen enters or attempts to enter Singapore without a valid entry/re-entry permit, endorsed permit while in company of the holder, valid pass, or s.56 exemption
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 6 months and caning of not less than 3 strokes; if not caneable under CPC s.325(1)(a) or (b), fine not exceeding $6,000 in lieu of caning (s.6(3)(a))

offence: Person departing Singapore (other than a citizen or s.56-exempt person) fails, when required, to complete and submit an embarkation form
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both (s.6(3)(b))

offence: Arrives in, enters, re-enters or remains in Singapore in contravention of a Minister's prohibition/limit order under s.9(1)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment for a presumptive minimum term of not less than 2 years and not more than 4 years, and liable to a fine not exceeding $6,000. Higher band in s.9(6) if prior qualifying conviction and different-name travel document

offence: Remains in Singapore without reasonable cause after cancellation of permit/certificate, s.14(4) declaration, or expiry/cancellation of pass, or in contravention of s.62 — period not exceeding 90 days
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $4,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 months or both

offence: Remains in Singapore without reasonable cause after cancellation of permit/certificate, s.14(4) declaration, or expiry/cancellation of pass, or in contravention of s.62 — period exceeding 90 days
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 6 months and caning of not less than 3 strokes; if not caneable under CPC s.325(1)(a) or (b), fine not exceeding $6,000 in lieu of caning

offence: Person removed from or otherwise lawfully sent out of Singapore enters or resides in Singapore without the Controller's prior written permission
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Not bailable (CPC default — max 3 years is 3 years or upwards)
punishment: Imprisonment for a presumptive minimum term of not less than 1 year and not more than 3 years, and liable to a fine not exceeding $6,000 (s.36(2))

offence: Attempts unlawfully to enter Singapore in contravention of any provision of this Act (other than s.6(1)) or the regulations
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment not exceeding 2 years and liable to a fine not exceeding $4,000 (s.57(1AA)(a))

offence: Abets any person to enter Singapore in contravention of this Act or the regulations
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment for a presumptive minimum term of not less than 6 months and not more than 2 years; plus caning of not less than 3 strokes if the abetment is within PC s.107(1)(b) or (c) and the offence abetted is punishable with caning; otherwise also liable to a fine not exceeding $6,000 (s.57(1AA)(b))

offence: Engages in the business or trade of conveying to or out of Singapore any person whom he or she knows or has reasonable grounds for believing is a prohibited immigrant
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment not less than 2 years and not more than 5 years, and caning of not less than 3 strokes (s.57(1AA)(d))

offence: Harbours a person knowing the person has acted in contravention of this Act or the regulations, or with reckless disregard as to that fact
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment for a presumptive minimum term of not less than 6 months and not more than 2 years, and liable to a fine not exceeding $6,000 (s.57(1AA)(e))

offence: Harbours a person, negligently failing to ascertain whether the person has acted in contravention of this Act or the regulations
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $6,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both (s.57(1AA)(f))

offence: Employs any person who has acted in contravention of s.6(1), s.15 or s.36(1) or the regulations
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment for a presumptive minimum term of not less than 6 months and not more than 2 years, and liable to a fine not exceeding $6,000 (s.57(1AA)(c), subject to s.57(1A)). Caning may apply if more than 5 immigration offenders employed at the same time — confirm s.57(1A) on SSO

offence: Occupier of a work place who has control of access permits an immigration offender to enter or remain at the work place
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailable: Bailable (CPC default — first max 12 months / subsequent max 2 years)
punishment: First: fine $15,000–$30,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 12 months or both, for each immigration offender found at the work place. Subsequent: fine $30,000–$60,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both, for each such offender (s.57A(6))

offence: For or in expectation of fee, gain or reward, assists, encourages or induces another person to give shelter to an immigration offender, and shelter is given in consequence
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment for a presumptive minimum term of not less than 6 months and not more than 2 years, and liable to a fine not exceeding $6,000

offence: Marriage of convenience — contracts/enters a marriage for an immigration advantage with gratification (s.57C(1)), or arranges such a marriage (s.57C(2))
arrestable: May arrest without warrant if the officer reasonably believes the person has committed an offence under this Act or the regulations (IA s.51(3) — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 10 years or both (s.57C(1) and (2) separately)
